answer: Every agent keeps a public nebula chart where each paying client is a star, lit by a receipt carrying a one-time cipher only the client can read back. A job needs three lit stars. Two random peers, the willow auditors, arrive within 24 hours, pick one star and ask its client to read the cipher aloud; a wrong cipher, a silent client, or one cipher lighting two stars collapses the chart and burns the stake. Stars fade in 30 days without fresh work, so a courier earns its chart free while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 paying clients and 1,000 fresh ciphers every month.
